subject: MAP: Load test scheduling & dedicated sizing (post-call recap)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Load test scheduling & dedicated sizing (post-call recap)

Hi John / Acme performance team,

Thanks again for the call earlier — great to sync. Per our MAP draft (attached), next milestone is a coordinated load/performance test so we can validate dedicated capacity sizing and confirm latency at peak QPS.

Quick recap & asks:
- Target test window: 2-3 hour traffic replay simulating peak QPS (you mentioned ~1.2k QPS sustained with 3k spikes).
- Replay dataset: you to provide a 24-hour sample trace or replay export (anonymized) + mapping of production endpoints.
- Redwood responsibilities: we will provision a dedicated capacity pool, run traffic replay, collect latency/throughput/cost metrics, and deliver a results deck.
- Acme responsibilities: provide replay data, confirm replay window/date, and designate a single point of contact for the run (we have you listed as POA).
- Dependencies: network whitelisting for the replay agent, test API keys, and confirmation of segments to exclude for PII.

Proposed schedule options (please confirm which works for you):
1) Thu 12 Mar 2026, 10:00 PT — short notice but quicker turnaround
2) Tue 17 Mar 2026, 09:00 PT — preferred on our side (more time to stage)
3) Thu 18 Mar 2026, 10:00 PT — backup

I've attached the updated MAP spreadsheet (MAP-draft-v2.xlsx) with milestone owners, target close date (MAP target: 2026-03-31), and the traffic replay spec (traffic-replay-specs.json) for your review.

Please reply with the preferred date and confirm you can share the replay export by EOD Monday 3/15. Once we lock the date, Aditya will follow up on sizing and exact infra footprint.

Thanks — looking forward to running this with you.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

Marissa — thanks for the summary. Confirming a few items from our side: we can provide a 24-hour anonymized trace and a sampling script that replays traffic to the same endpoints. Peak numbers: ~1,200 QPS sustained for ~15 minutes during peak hour, with short spikes to ~3,000 QPS for <1 minute.

We prefer Tue 17 Mar 2026 at 09:00 PT if that works for your infra team. I will be the primary POC, and I've cc'd our perf team — they will share the replay export by EOD Monday 3/15 as requested.

One ask: please call out the dedicated capacity sizing you plan to provision for the test (node count / GPU type) so we can align on cost estimates upstream.

John / Marissa,

Thanks — quick technical note on sizing and replay: based on the numbers (1.2k sustained, 3k spikes), recommended starting point for the run is a dedicated pool of 4 x A100 (40GB) or equivalent (we'll use mixed precision/quantized model pack to reduce memory pressure). That should give headroom for spikes and keep observed p99 latency under target. If you want a closer match to production latency with caching behavior, send a replay that includes realistic session affinity (we'll need KV-cache keys mapped).

For the test itself:
- Replay window: 30–60 minutes for the spike-focused run, followed by a 2-hour steady-state run at 1.2k QPS to measure cost/throughput.
- Artifacts we need from Acme: replay export (JSON lines or PCAP-like trace), endpoint mapping, and a list of headers to allow/strip for PII.
- Whitelisting: please open outbound to our replay agents at 34.200.18.55 and 34.200.18.56, and provide an ephemeral test API key (we'll delete after the run).

I'll prepare a sizing doc and share it in the MAP spreadsheet; happy to run a dry-run earlier if you want to validate reproducers.

—Aditya
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai

Summary of MAP milestone (load test) and owners:
- Date/time: 2026-03-17 09:00 PT
- Redwood responsibilities: provision dedicated pool (Aditya), run traffic replay, collect metrics, deliver results deck and recommended next steps (Marissa to own the ticketing to stakeholders).
- Acme responsibilities: share replay export by 2026-03-15 EOD, provide test API key and whitelisting by 2026-03-16 EOD, designate test day POC (John).
- Target close date for this MAP milestone: 2026-03-31 (incorporates time for follow-up tuning and rollouts).
- Dependencies: network whitelisting, dataset anonymization, and legal/PO sign-off if we need longer data retention.

Next steps:
1) John: send replay export to the shared Drive link above and confirm whitelisting (Perf team).
2) Aditya: share the sizing doc and confirm exact node/GPU types by 3/13.
3) Marissa: I'll schedule the test in our ops calendar and send the test run plan + invite to all stakeholders.

If anything changes, flag asap. Otherwise we'll treat this milestone as on-path for the MAP and proceed with the Tue 3/17 run.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
